C_COD_CAUSES_DIAGNOSED.rationale: The candidate clearly diagnoses all three core arithmetic defects: (1) calculating the discount amount itself rather than subtracting it from the total, (2) reading only the first coupon code at index 0 rather than summing multiple coupons, and (3) allowing the balance to become negative when coupons exceed the discounted total. For each defect, the response provides an independent cause and a specific remedy.
